review.why: Production shows a near-black full-page login, a lime-dot TapMart label, rounded dark inputs and a glowing lime Sign in button. These do not demonstrate the approved mineral #F4F3EF working canvas, restrained graphite regions, exact frame mark, cobalt #2450E8 actions or application typography. The Lab establishes those tokens through its graphite rail and open working field, but its discovery composition is not a Search template: Search should not acquire its people ribbon, car shelf or source-to-commitment offsets merely to match the reference. No Search field, grouped results, record statuses, financial semantics, result destinations or selected app navigation are visible in production. Consequently, no real-data differences or Search functionality can be verified, and the visible legacy login should not be misreported as evidence of Search-specific styling regressions.
review.verdict: Do not sign off: the production capture shows sign-in rather than Search, leaving both Frame Shift fidelity and real Search functionality unverified.
